Subject: HealthGrid launch readiness: staff rotations, calendar slots and bridge owners

Hi Sofia / Rajiv —

Thanks again for the kickoff call request. We want to lock a 60-minute Day 0 session to align launch roles, ownership, and the first two-week rollout cadence. Proposed windows (all PT):

- Tue Aug 13, 10:00–11:00
- Wed Aug 14, 14:00–15:00
- Thu Aug 15, 08:30–09:30

Please confirm which slot works best and who from your side will own the onboarding success sponsor and procurement touchpoint.

Attendees we plan to include from Redwood: Hannah (launch owner), Jonas (technical lead), Monica (CS lead), Ben (ops/bridges). If you want additional Redwoods on the invite (SRE/DevRel), flag it and we’ll add.

Draft Day 0 agenda (rough):
- 0:00–0:05: Intros and goals
- 0:05–0:20: Platform overview + integration checklist (Jonas)
- 0:20–0:35: Mutual Action Plan review & first two-week milestones (Hannah/Monica)
- 0:35–0:50: Bridge and escalation paths, SSO/access (Ben)
- 0:50–1:00: Next steps + calendar owners and doc links

I attached a lightweight Mutual Action Plan and a kickoff agenda PDF; once you confirm a time I’ll send a calendar invite with the Zoom bridge and add the doc links.

Thanks — talk soon,

Hannah Schmitt
Customer Success Lead | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.com

Attachments: HealthGrid_MutualActionPlan_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), Kickoff_Agenda_v3.pdf (pdf)

From: Sofia Torres <sofia.torres@healthgrid.com>

Subject: Re: HealthGrid launch readiness: staff rotations, calendar slots and bridge owners

Thanks Hannah —

Wed Aug 14 14:00–15:00 PT works best for our group. I’ll be the onboarding sponsor and Rajiv will handle technical attendance. Procurement (procurement@healthgrid.com) asked to be looped for the first call so they can confirm billing/contact owners.

A couple of asks from our side:
- Can you confirm whether we should expect SSO setup questions during Day 0 or if that goes to a follow-up technical deep-dive?
- We’d like the MAP to include a clear owner for the initial access checklist (who will submit SSO metadata).

I’ll add the proposed attendees on our side (including a small procurement rep) when you send the invite.

Sofia
Sofia Torres
Director, Product Ops | HealthGrid
sofia.torres@healthgrid.com

Perfect — locking Wed Aug 14, 14:00–15:00 PT. I’ll send a calendar invite from Redwood (placeholder now, final will include the Zoom link).

Quick answers to your asks:
- SSO/setup: we’ll cover access expectations on Day 0 at a high level and capture metadata owners. SSO verification and SAML metadata exchange should be scheduled as a technical follow-up (we typically set that in week 1).
- MAP owner: assigning Rajiv (your tech lead) as SSO metadata owner in the MAP is fine; I’ll mark the action item. If Rajiv prefers, we can set Monica as the coordinator from the CS side.

Proposed attendee roster (Redwood) — please confirm:
- Hannah Schmitt (CS lead) — meeting owner / MAP steward
- Jonas Weber (Solutions Eng) — integration checklist & technical lead
- Monica Patel (Customer Ops) — onboarding milestones & docs
- Ben Carter (Infrastructure Ops) — bridge + escalation owner

I attached updated MAP with owners filled for the items we already discussed. Link to shared doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1A2B3C4D-healthgrid-kickoff

Next steps (I’ll do these right after you confirm):
1) Send calendar invite with Zoom bridge + attachments.
2) Create a HubSpot kickoff task and tag RG-3471.
3) Share an access checklist template (short form) for Rajiv to populate before the technical deep-dive.

If that looks good I’ll hit send on the invites now.

—Hannah
